reason: A standalone utility plugin that fail-fast parses supported Chinese relative-time phrases and ISO 8601 values into structured timestamps, with no documented external service access or side effects.

summaries.zh: 将支持的中文自然语言相对时间短语和 ISO 8601 时间转换为结构化时间戳，并在无法识别时返回明确错误。
summaries.en: Parses supported Chinese natural-language relative times and ISO 8601 values into structured timestamps, returning explicit errors for unsupported input.

capabilities: Parses supported Chinese natural-language relative time phrases
Converts supported time expressions and ISO 8601 inputs into ISO timestamps
Accepts an optional IANA time zone and reference time
Returns structured parse results and errors without scheduling or external actions
